title: PhaseOutput
description: Canonical contract for the JSON form of MCP/orchestrator/worker_contracts.py::PhaseOutput. Mirrors the dataclass shape so downstream phase-output report writers (inter-tier 02_validation_report, post-rewrite 02_validation_report, imscc_chunks manifest, eval report) can validate against a single shared schema. Wave 1 authors the schema only; no consumer wires against it yet — Wave 3 (Governance G1) consumes promotion_decision via the promotion-chain aggregator.

run_id.description: Workflow run identifier the phase output belongs to.

outputs.description: Free-form per-phase output payload; consumers parse by phase_name.

artifacts.description: Filesystem paths (as strings) of artifacts produced by the phase.

gate_results.description: Map of gate_id -> GateResult emitted by lib.validators against this phase output.

decision_captures_path.description: Filesystem path to this phase's decision-capture JSONL, or null when no captures were emitted.

status.description: Phase-level execution outcome (orthogonal to gate-level pass/fail).

promotion_decision.description: Per-phase promotion verdict consumed by the Wave 3 promotion-chain aggregator (Governance G1). OPTIONAL — registered in properties but NOT in required[]. Wave 1 leaves the field unset on every emit; Wave 3 derives the value at emit time via derive_promotion_decision(status, gate_results).

error.description: Error message when status='fail'; null otherwise.

metrics.description: Per-phase numeric / structured metrics (timings, counts, scores).
